newsitem.title: UK: BP does not plan Lavera shutdown.
newsitem.headline: BP does not plan Lavera shutdown.

text.p: British Petroleum Co Plc said on Tuesday it was still considering what to do with its Lavera refinery in southern France.
But the firm's chief executive said a shut-down was not among the options being mulled at the moment.
BP said early in 1996 it wanted to sell Lavera as well as its Lima refinery in the U.S. and close its Pernis plant near Rotterdam.
BP has already decided to close Lima instead and announced earlier today to shut Pernis by the end of this year, which was earlier than anticipated.
The refinery moves are part of BP's measures to beat depressed margins and general overcapacity in the downstream industry.
